limits: TRAIN descriptive counters only; no heldout significance or generalization claim.
G4 any-top6 exact page-wave equality is an algebraic certificate, not native completion latency.
All G4 controls have396programmedpages/chip, one copy,48selectedpages/query/chip, one reserved four-plane block/chip. No additional replicas/inactive overfetch.

Page ledgers preserve unique logical pages but do not establish complete-row instruction legality, PB ownership, row-fringe outputs, accumulator switches, ECC stalls, sustained CR, or vector/control/output traffic.
Down uses different expert inputs and is outside the common-input GU page-wave model.
Fixed one/two-plane bins are separate static controls. They do not establish the general IPR capability or allow route-dependent page remapping.
Generic matching control eliminates layout novelty under identical capabilities; research attribution must come from validated native lowering/execution if a useful advantage survives.

global_roundrobin_comparison.note: Equal programmed bytes but compensation uses an extra reserved four-plane block; common capacity comparison must allow/pay three blocks for all controls.

Deep_crossblock_audit.claims: 44 is aggregate page-work lower bound only. Static compact placement crosses blocks. Do not call this 44 consecutive same-block CR reads or native latency.

no_headroom_cases.conclusion: The shared-compensation mechanism is unavailable. P=6 still leaves phase/IPR opportunities, but all-top6 9-wave guarantee is impossible for static integer page profiles over64experts: some plane is heavy in at least16experts, so choose6 heavy experts.

no_headroom_cases.condition: P divisible by4 and every expert balanced over4planes
no_headroom_cases.conclusion: Per-expert and aggregate IPR sense-wave counts both equal K*P/4. With balanced shared pages this remains exact: zero page-wave headroom for this mechanism. Cold starts/commands can still differ and require native model.

generic_control.explanation: A generic sparse page/row compiler granted exactly the candidate's page-order/partial-row/selected-page execution capability emits the identical static one-copy ledger. Joint shared compensation is elementary water filling; no algorithm/layout novelty follows. If native complete-row constraints forbid it, they forbid both equally.

identity.ordering: Ascending issued WL; all addresses in one block. Skipped addresses alone assumed CR-compatible, omitted plane epochs not assumed hot.

conditional_keep_hot.capability_unproven: Requires per-plane validity metadata and conditional discard before shared ECC/PE; full array reading retains one page/PB perplane but PB ownership still needs native audit.

sparse_mask_CR_gap_audit.interpretation: sameWL page unions are not uninterrupted per-plane CR runs. Every inactive-to-active transition after the first is a potential cold restart under strict no-interval CR. Conditional full-wave inactive reads can keep everyplane reading, at explicit physical overfetch; drop-before-ECC is an additional execution capability, not established.
